bootstrap.unit: physical task/initial-state setting; all methods and seeds kept together
bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive paired bootstrap intervals on previously examined states; no confirmatory significance claims.

verification.timing_note: Historical fixed controls did not collect FM diagnostics and used a different CPU thread count. Their raw times are retained but are not a controlled latency comparison with new capped runs.

timing_comparability: Fixed versus adaptive timing is confounded by diagnostic instrumentation and Torch CPU thread count; compare model calls instead.
